tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search the TradingAIHub directory of AI tools for finance and trading (MCP servers, agent skills, APIs) by keywords, e.g. "stock prices", "crypto exchange", "options". Tools matching all words rank first. Returns the best matches with slug, links, pricing and weekly verification status.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Full details for one tool in the TradingAIHub directory by its slug (from search_tools): its TradingAIHub page (url) and vendor link (website_url; labelled when it is an affiliate link), homepage, docs, repo, remote MCP URL, pricing, license, npm/PyPI packages, GitHub stars and verification status.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: All categories of the TradingAIHub directory with their slug, description and number of tools.
